description:
Amentum is seeking a Software Engineer to support Naval projects in Dahlgren, VA. This position will support the design, development, integration, and testing of software for DoW weapons and sensor systems. The Software Engineer will work as part of a systems and software engineering team supporting mission-critical applications and modernization efforts.

 Software Engineer Responsibilities Include: 

 Develop software using C and C++ programming languages.
 Use Git for software repository and configuration management.
 Use Jira for backlog and task management.
 Support continuous integration (CI) activities.
 Perform software requirements analysis and software design.
 Collaborate with engineering teams to develop and integrate software solutions.
 Support software development activities throughout the development lifecycle.
 Perform analysis and problem-solving in support of technical and engineering requirements.
 
 Minimum Requirements: 

 0–10 years of relevant experience. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another applicable technical field , or equivalent experience in lieu of the education requirement.
 Experience with or knowledge of C/C++ software development .
 Experience with software development tools and configuration management processes.
 Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an engineering team.
 Must have an active secret security clearance Note: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a Secret clearance. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Prior software development or systems engineering experience supporting Surface Combat Systems or DoD Weapons Systems .
 Experience with embedded systems and real-time operating systems .
 Experience with Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) algorithms .
 Knowledge or experience with hypersonic trajectories .
 Systems engineering experience supporting the development and integration of software systems on surface ships and subsurface boats .
 Experience with the integration, testing, and evaluation of software using hardware simulators .
        
 Compensation Details: 
$110000        
 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.
  
 Benefits Overview: 
 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:
 Health, dental, and vision insurance

 Paid time off and holidays

 Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

 Educational reimbursement

 Parental leave

 Employee stock purchase plan

 Tax-saving options

 Disability and life insurance

 Pet insurance

  
 Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits. 
        
 Original Posting: 
10/02/2026 - Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs.
